dkarachagadakar chagashes rig gi gnad don skor gleng ba (2)nang ba'i lta spyod kyis mi chos la phan min skor — (9)nang bstan gyis mi gzhi'i rin thang la phan thog min gyi bgro gleng (13)gangs ri'i gzhon skyes rnams kyi 'gan 'khri'i skor gleng ba (17)grwa btsun tsho'i mdun rgyab kyi gnad don skor gyi lta tshul — — — — (23)bshad grwa'i byung rim mdo tsam brjod pa— (29) jo nang ba'i 'gan bab skor gleng ba (35)bgro gleng gi lta phyogs — 1 ('gyu0)

dgar gagazhan stong gi lta ba la rags tsam dpyad pa (45)chos dbyings gcig du bral yin min la dpyad pa (56) rigs lam blo gsal dga' skyed— — (61)thos bsam gling shes rig gi sgrig gzhi (73)slob ma'i sgrig yig (85)rgyugs sprod sgrig gzhi (100) chos grogs tshor phul ba'i re zhus (105)—2

mtsham ra dorabasugartsom pa 'o mtshams sbyor mdor bsnus/de yang dkon mchog chos go ni spyi (1972)lor rnga yul bu nang du skyes/ rang lo bdun tsam nas mkhas grub bye ba'i bsti gnas bse dgon gyi chos grwar zhugs te/ a khu kun dga'i drung nas klog bslabs/(1979)lor bla ma rin po che kun dga' zugs rje dpal gyi mdun sar rab byung bsgrubs thub pa ma zad/ rjes su yang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa dang / dus 'khor dbang chen dang rgyud sde rab 'byams sogs zab bka' mang du zhus/ de'i tshe khong gis/ thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas jo nang ba'i bstan par phan thogs can zhig yong ba'i shis smon gnang ba'i skal bzang thob/rang lo bcu gsum steng mkhar rin po che'i drung du kun mkhyen gsung 'bum cha tshang dang /lam rim gyi khrid lung thob/(1988)lor bla ma blo bzang ༷phrin las kyi sku mdun nas/ phar

mtsham spyoramadorabasu /phyin dang dbu ma dus 'khor bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi gdams pa mang du zhus/ mkhan rin po che snang ba dpal gyi drung nas bsdus grwa dang sbyor drug spyi don sogs la thos bsam byas/ de rjes a mchog mtshan nyid dang / lha ldan 'bras spungs su bskyod de rgan chos 'phel rnam rgyal dang rgan bstan dar sogs las blo rtags bsdus gsum la sbyangs pa byas/spyi lo (1995) lor 'phags yul 'bras spungs sgo mang du grwa sar zhugs te/ don bdun cu nas bka' rams 'dzin grwa'i bar phar mngon dbu gsum la rgyugs sprod kyi lam nas slob gnyer mthar phyin byas/ de tsam du ma zad sku mdun gyi drung nas lam sngags gnyis dang dus dbang dang grol mchog khrid brgya kha skong dang bcas pa mnos pa ma zad / khong gi mdun nas dbu ma gzhan stong gi dam bca' 'jog pa'i go skabs byung / —(1992) lor bse dgon gyi dpe khrid dge rgan byed dgos pa'i re ba ltar lo gnyis kyi ring /pe khrid kyi 'gan khur dgos byung

mtsham sbyar dor bsugab dngakaspyi lo (2004)lor yang bskyar dpe khrid dge rgan du nan bskul byas pa ltar / 'phags yul nas phyir rang dgon du bskyod de/thos bsam gling 'di khrims gzhi zhig gis stangs 'dzin gyi 'og tu 'gro dgos pa shin tu gal chen du mthong ste/ shes rig gi srid jus gtan la phabs nas gtso bo jo nang rang rkang ba'i yig cha 'chad khrid byed par rang gzhan thams cad la rting skul byed mus su yod/(2005)lor rdo rje 'chang bla ma gsal ldan gyi sku mdun nas sbyor drug gi nyams khrid cha tshang blangs/ da skabs bse dgon gyi mdo sngags thos bsam gling gi dge rgan gyi 'gan khur ba'i thog nas/ jo nang kun phan lhan tshogs dang / gzhan stong bgro gleng tshogs pa/ jo nang dpe rnying bsdu sgrig tshogs pa bcas kyi nang du las 'gan khur te bstan pa la zhabs 'degs ci thub byed dang byed bzhin mchis/ rtsom pa po nas/
sa/stan n+da ja baḍi

dpyadartsom/shes rig gi gnad don skor gleng ba/mi rigs shig 'tsho sdod dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro min ni mi rigs de'i rig gnas kyi phan nus dang / rin thang la thug pas/nga tshos snang tshod dang grags tshod tsam gyi rjes su mi 'gro bar kha ba'i shes rig gi ngo bo dang / khyab bya khyab byed sogs la bsam gzhigs dang bgro gleng gnad du things pa zhig byed rgyu de 'u cag gi 'gan ci'akhri zhig tu mthong stabs de'i skor gleng ba la spro ba skyes/shes rig gi 'phel rim dang ngo bo/mtho sgang du 'tsho sdod byed pa'i kha ba'i yab mes gong ma tshos/'gro ba spyi'i bsam spyod la dbye zhib byas te/ spyi tshogs kyi 'dod 'dun dang / gnad don rnams thag gcod thub pa'i rig gzhung zhig bsgrun pas/ mi rigs 'phel rgyas dang / chig sgril dag la 2

ba dgonane+e rigadape ཿga /phan rlabs byung / yin na'ang daphyod ldan 'gas srol rgyun gyi shes rig gi ngo bo rgas drags pas da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi gshed mar nges stabs/ 'di 'u cag gis btsan tshugs kyis bcom brlag dang gtor bshigagatong dgos par 'dod mod/ de lta na shul du gsar ba gang zhig gis mi rigs kyi ngo bo dang / chig sgril gyi rmang gzhi sgrun/ zhib tu bsam dgos/'on kyang snyan grags can gyi tshan rig pa dang mnyam zhib pa mang pos/ bod kyi rig gzhung gi ngo bo dang / phan nus la dpyad zhib byas te/ tshan rig dang rkya sgril du 'gro thub par nges pa rnyed pa ma zad/ da dung kho tshos chos lugs kyi go don las brgal te mtshan nyid dang dngos gshis rig pa'i ma lag tshang zhing / tshan rig gong mthor gtong ba'i sgul shugs shig red snyam gyi 'dugader brten/ nga tshos rig gzhung gi ngo bo sngogs dus de ni lha mo rtsis gsum dang mthu mnan byad gsum tsam min par kha ba'i skad yig gi rmang gzhi la 'tshe med kyis rgyas btab pa'i bsam spyod kyi bsdus 3

dpyad gapa'i gzhung lugs shig red 'dug la/ 'di 'u cag gis dam 'dzin gyis 'dzin skyong byed ma thub tshe/ gzhan gyis gces nor du 'gyur nyen che stabs/ nga tsho'i tshor rtog rnon pos mno bsam gtong rgyu dus la bab yod/rig gzhung gi phan nus/spyir lo stong phrag du ma'i gong sa sgang 'dir 'tsho sdod byed pa'i mi tshogs chags pa nas da bar 'u cag bde sdug gi rang bzhin can du gyur ba las 'phul 'khor gyi thon rdzas ltar grub med par grags shing spub/ de'i phyir 'u tsho'i rig gzhung 'di mi'i 'tsho sdod la mkho dgos dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ de yang mi'i spyi tshogs chags pa nas da bar bde sdug gi tshor shugs skyen drags pa'i thob shor dang re dogs mang po zhig rang cag gi gshed ma'i tshul du gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung dang 'byung bzhin yod la/ na zug gi sdug bsngal 'di dag chags snang rmongs gsum gyi kun 'byung 4

ba dgornargo rigad tshogagashugs drags pa las byung bas/ nga tshos bdag med rtogs ba'i shes rab dang bzod sran dag nyams len du bstar tshe/ spyi tshogs kyi khor yug tu de dag bri ste zhi bde'i drod khol zhig nges par ster thub/ de bas kyang da lta'i spyi tshogs khrod g.yo rgyu khram gsum dang /gsod 'phrog bcom gsum gyi yo lang ches cher rgyas pa de rgyal khrims kyis gcun thabs byed kyang / phan thogs cher 'byung gi med la/ 'di dag 'dod rngam dang sger sems shugs drags pa las byung bas/ byams brtses dag 'bud chen po zhig byed thub nges yin/shes gsal ltar na nye ba'i char dpal 'byor dang snyan grags shugs cher snyegs bzhin yod la/ 'di dag gzhan brten gyi rten 'brel las 'grub kyi yod phyir/ rten 'byung gi lta grub 'dis kyang mi'i 'tsho gnas la gnod byed kyi med par sems/ lhag par las dbang ni skyid sdug dang dar rgud skyed byed kyi rgyu'i nus pa zhig tu khas len gyi yod stabs/ des spyi tshogs kyi nag nyes yod tshad 5

daphyadartsom/'gog srung thub pa ma zad/ bde sdug mtha' dag rang gi spobs pa dang rtsol ba las bsgrun par bskul bas/ mi chos nang rin thang che/'u cag su yin yang longs spyod sbyin gtong dang bzang spyod rnams srung ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng dka' ngal la ci mi snyam pa'i bzod sran dang / las don la dga' bzhin spro bzhin du sems gnas nas phan nus so sor 'byed pas phar phyin drug lag len du 'khel ba yin na spyi sger gang yin yang mi tshe bzang po zhig skyel ba gdon mi za/ der brten/ nang bstan gyi gzhung lugs las byung ba'i theg pa che chung gi phan nus la mngon rjes kyi rigs pas sngogs 'don byas te 'tsho ba dang lag ldang 'brel nus na phan thogs shin tu che bar 'khums/rig gzhung ji ltar 'dzin tshul skor/mi rigs shig 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos na rgud pa'i rkyen rtsa 'tshol zhing brtags dgos mod/ 'dir 'u cag gi shes dgos pa 6

ba dargonane+e rigadapecug /zhig la 'dzam gling 'dir dus rabs bco brgyad pa nas lo rabs kha shas kyi ring tshan rig 'phel rgyas su song ste mi'i bkyes skom sel thub par brten chos lugs mkho med du bsam mkhan mang du byung ba ma zad/ rdzas 'phrul kho na la brten nas rang gi bde skyid yongs rdzogs bsgrun par yid ches byas yod/'on kyang dus rabs de dag gi nang phyi'i dpal yon gong mthor phyin yod pa las mi'i bsam blo'i nang ma skyid pa dang /'jigs dngangs lu gu rgyud du gnas yod stabs/yang bskyar chos lugs la skyabs 'tshol mkhan mang du byung ba'i gtan tshigs 'dis/ nga tshos srol rgyun yod tshad la rgol rdung gtong mi nyen pa shes/ da dung dpyad bsdur la gzhol dgos pa zhig la/ rig gzhung 'di 'u cag gi nyer mkho'i rten 'brel las byung zhing mtho sgang du mtshar longs byung bas/ nga tsho dang 'grogs 'dris shin tu zab/ de'i phyir rang cag su yin yang mdun bskyod kyi thabs lam rnal ma zhig med par gsar bsgyur gyi 'ur sgrog ci tsam byas 7

daphyad ma/kyang phan pa las gnod par sems/ des na 'u tshos rgud pa'i rtsa ba chos lugs 'then 'khyer dang lung tshan dbye 'byed kyi gtsos gna' deng zung du zel nas shes rig sbyangs brtson ma thub pa 'dis nga tsho mun dong du yang yang bskyar zhing 'phel rgyas kyi srog rtsar rgol gyin 'dug der brten 'u cag gi btsan tshugs kyis 'di dag bcom brlag dang gtor bshig gtong dgos la/ shul du mkho dgos dang ldan pa'i srol rgyun gyi rig gzhung gi steng du skye dngos rdzas gsum dang dpal 'byor rig pa tshad 'phel ba zhig khyab spel byed thub tshe mi rabs 'di dang mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyi mdun lam la 'od stong spro bar the tshom bral/

ba dananane+e rigadathetshogaganang ba'i lta smyod kyis michos la gen min skor gyi bgro smrenganaspyir shes rig rnams spyi tshogs su dgos mkho yod med kyi sgo nas phan gnod can du gyur ba las/ bzang ngan gyi ngo bo ther zug tu grub med stabs/rtog ge'i 'gros kyis nang ba'i lta spyod kyi rin thang la dpyad na/nang ba'i lta spyod ni/mu stegs pa'i spub mtha'i rigs pa dang mi 'dra zhingaka nub gling ba'i dngosastod snyegs tshul dang mi mtshungs par rang mtshan can du grub yod/ de 'drar grub rkyen ni/'gro ba mi'i rang gshis de 'phrul 'khor gyi thon rdzas ltar spub med par bde ba 'dod la sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa can du lhun grub tu gyur bas/ 'tshol snyegs de rjogs pa pa la shes rig grags che ba mang du byung mod/'on te ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos lta spyod 9

dpyad gagasar ba zhig spel na 'gab che bar gzigs nas lta ba rten 'byung dang spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa spel 'go brtsams/khong gis mtho dman su yin yang lta spyod de gnyis la gzhol thub na/ phan bde'i 'bras bzang phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar 'tsho ba'i rol rtsed las rnyed btub rgyu mang du yod pa rgyu mtshan du byo ste/ yang yang bskul bas/ spyi tshogs khyon yongs kyi khor yug tu 'tshe bas mi bde ba dang dka' rnyog rgyud mar 'byung ba shes mkhan mang du byung ba ma zad/ gzhan dang gzhan la 'tshe ba byol na/ rang nyid la rogs skyor dang mnga' thang 'byung bar rtogs mkhan gcig rjes gnyis mthud du mang du byung la/ de'i stabs kyis/ zhi bde ni mna' 'brel gyi tshogs pa du mas/ rtag brtan gyi bde skyid du sgrog mkhan dang / 'tshol mkhan gyi g.yo skyom chen po byung dang 'byung bzhin mchis/ phyogs gzhan nas gzhigs na/ spyi tshogs khyon yongs kyi khor yug nang gzhan gyi bde don gtsigs cher 'dzin thub na/ rang nyid kyi snyan grags dang stobs 'byor rnams 10

ba dgonane+e rigadaspre tshogagagong 'thor gtong bar da lta'i no be zhi bde'i bya dga' thob pa dag las ra sprod thub par brten/ 'tshe ba med pa'i khyad nor 'di/ 'tsho ba'i nying bcud bsrubs pa'i rig gzhung zhig yin par spub thub yod/ yang gcig dpyad na/ dngos po'i gshis bab ni/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pa la brten dgos pa las skabs 'brel gyi rgyu rkyen la ma brten par mi 'byung bas/ 'gro ba mi'i dpal 'byor 'du 'god dang thob thang rnams rang la shes 'jon ji ltar yod na yang spyi tshogs la brten dgos par grags shing grub/ gal te spyi tshogs zhig la ma brten par rang nyid gcig pus 'phral phugs kyi bde don 'thus tshang zhig sgrub mi thub par chos nyid du grub pa'i rigs pa 'dis/ lta ba rten 'byung yang 'tsho ba dngos kyi sgyu rtsal gyi bro bcud cig yin par go btub/der brten/ nang ba'i lta spyod 'di nub gling ba dang mu stegs pa'i lta spub dang mi mtshungs pa'i ho bag can du gyur yod/de bas na 'di bod kyi mkhas pa dag gis gzhung thog nas gting 11

dasud —zab pa tsam du ma bzhag par lag lan zhun bdar gyi khrod nas mi ser dkyus ma rnams la mi gzhi'i rin thang dngaka legs byang gong 'phel du gtong bar legs skyes su phul yod stabs/ dus rabs nyi rtsaba'i smad nas nang bstan 'di phyi gling ba'i dpyad zhib pa rnam pas spyi tshogs gong 'phel du gtong ba'i sgul shugs su mthong ste do snang byed mkhan nyin re las nyin rer mang du 'gro bzhin mchis/de'i phyir 'u cag bod mi mtho dman drag zhan thams cad kyis lag len du bkol ba la sngar las 'thos sgo je tshang du 'gyur bar dpyad pa gsum dang rigs pa bzhis brtags te/ snyigs dor bcud len gyi thabs jus gya nom pa spel thub na sa sgang hril bor dgos mkho shin tu che bar 'khums/ mdor 'dril na/ nang bstan gyi lte gnad du gyur ba'i shes rig rnams lag len gyi sgo nas dngos yod 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho can du bsgyur rgyu da lta'i char gal 'gangs shin tu che snyam/12

ba dargon ne+e rigad tshogaganaja bsnyan gyis mi gagi'i rin thang la 2na thogs min skor kyi lta tshul/nang bstan gyi gzhung lugs la rtog ge'i 'gros kyi dpyad bsdur dang / nyams len kyi lam nas 'grogs 'dris bgyis tshe/nang bstan shes rig ni spyi tshogs bag 'khum dang rjes lus su thebs byed cig ma yin par dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi sgo nas 'gro ba spyi'i rigs la phan thog byed cig red/ de yang ston pa thub pa'i dbang bos dngos po'i gshis lugs dang mthun par chos sgo ji snyed cig bka' stsal yod pa las/ chos nyid bde gshegs snying po lus can kun la 'dra mtshungs su yod par bstan pa de/ spyi tshogs kyi blo stobs 'don spel dang drang bden bla med 'phel ba'i sgrul shugs su spub/ de'i tshul deng thog 'gro ba mi 13

dpadartso /su 'dra zhig yin yang mthar thug gi mgon du 'gyur rgyu yod par gsal ched du/ ston pa rang nyid kyis dka' spyad la brtson te 'jig rten 'di'i zhi bde'i ded dpon du gyur ba'i mdzad bzang gis/ 'gro ba mi su yin yang rang nyid ches yon tan can du 'gyur du rung bar yid rton nas de'i byed thabs la gzhol dgos par sgrub phyogs nas khrid ston dang / bdag nyid thob thang dma' zhing mthar thug gi bde skyid mi dbang bar lta ba ni yar thon med par le lo can du sgyur byed tshabs can zhig yin par dgag phyogs nas mig dpe bstan 'dugad dung dpyad bsdur la gzhol na/ khong gis dbyings de 'gro ba kun la yod par rigs lam nas thag chod thub thabs su skabs bab kyi rten 'brel las 'bras bu'i he bag dang / rkyen dbang gis bzang ngan can du bsgyur tu btub pa rnams rgyu mtshan tu byo ste yang yang bstan pas/ spyi tshogs khyon yon gyi nang du rang nyid grub tsam nas mtho dman gyi ngo bo ther zug tu grub med 14

—ba dgonane+e rigadasgetshog /par/ rang gi byed thabs gya nom pa spel ba'i lag rjes su 'gro ldog byed par rtogs mkhan chu'i gnyer ma bzhin mang du byung /de'i stabs kyis/ khams 'dra mnyam du yod pa ni 'gro ba mi'i rang dbang dang / drang bden bcas gyi rmang gzhi yin par nyams myong gi gseb nas rtogs te/ 'gro ba mi'i nang du rigs rus mtho dman dang kha dog dkar nag gi khyad med par thob thang 'dra mnyam du yod dgos par 'tshol mkhan dang rtogs mkhan gyi mtho rlabs 'phyur ba ma zad/ 'gro ba mi zhig yin phyin las la brtson na rang nyid mthor 'degs byed thub pa'i blo spobs bla lhag tu 'phel bar gyur/der brten/ nang bstan gyis 'dzam gling hril bo'i dka' rnyog dang / 'gro ba spyi'i legs byang rnams gong mthor gtong bar rigs lam nas r+shag chod thub kyi 'dug 'on te gzhung lugs dang bod brgyud nang bstan du nyams len la gtsigs 'dzin byed pa'i sngar srol bzang bo gnyis zung 'brel ma bgyis par gzhung 15

dupyadartsogalugs rang thog nas gting zab pa tsam gyis chog shes par bldad pa yin na nang bstan don dam par 'phel rgyas kyis dben pa shin tu mad/ de bas na bod brgyud nang bstan gyi rtsa gnad rnams lag len gyi khrod nas khyab spel byed rgyu ni dus rabs la mkho ba'i blang bya gal chen zhig tu 'khums/

ba da nane+e rind tshog gangs ri'i gzhon skyes rnams kyi 'gan 'khri'i skor gleja ba/mi rigs shig 'jig rten du 'tsho gnas byed min de mi rigs de'i son rtsa'i gzhon skyes rnams kyi shes yon sbyangs brtson dang 'gan 'khri khur thub min la thug pas/ da lta'i char 'dzam gling hril bo'i mi tshogs rnams kyis rang nyid gang du gtogs pa'i rigs tshan re'i 'gan bab la ches cher snyegs bzhin yod pa ltar/nga tsho'i gzhon skyes rnams kyis kyang rang rigs kyi dmigs 'dun la 'tshol snyegs dang 'bad 'bungs byed rgyu ni/ rang nyid la chos nyid kyis dz+rad pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin pa ma zad/rang nyid rin thang can du sgrun byed cig yin stabs/ ci nas kyang gzhol dgos pa'i 'u cag gi gzhon skyes rnams kyi 'gan 'khri'i skor gleng ba la/7

dpyad ma/gcig gzhon skyes tsho'i 'gan bab/ spyir mi rigs zhes pa ni thun mong min pa'i bsam blo dang skad yig goms srol dpal 'byor rnams kyi khyad chos kyi sgo nas 'jog dgos la/ khyad nor de dag las mi rigs shig legs lam can du bskyod dgos na gtso bo rigs tshan de'i grub cha'i mi rnams kyi bsam blo rang rkya ba zhig yong bar bya rgyu ni shin tu 'gangs che'i gnad donazhig tu grub yod pa red/ der brten nga tsho'i gzhon skyes rnams kyi bsam blo rang gi 'dod pa dang mthun par snyegs dgos pa ma zad/ kher tshugs can du gnas thub dgos mod/'on te don dngos su de las ldog ste rang rgya mi thub par gzhan dbang du gyur ba yin na gzhan la lad zlos dngaka 'gran bsdur gyi ngo bor gyur nas dus tshod gang 'tsham phyin mthar dmigs 'bras 18 tsho

ba dgenane+e rigadapetshog /gang yang mi 'byin pa ma zad/ mjug tu re thang chad nas mi tshe don med du skyel bzhin pa'i gnas tshul 'byung ba 'di yang bsam blo tshad thub zhig med pas red/ de bas na bsam blo rang rkya ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng / mi rigs shig gi gnad don rnams thag chod pa'i skad yig gi rmang gzhi nges can zhig yong bar brtson te chab dpal rig gsum gyi khrod du bed chod thub pa yin na mi rigs shig sra brtan can du 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ 'on kyang skad yig rgyun 'dzin dang khyab spel ma byas par nyams rlag tu gyur ba yin na/mi rigs kyi gson shugs chad tshar ba yin pa mkhas blun kun la grags shing grub/ de'i stabs kyis bod kyi skad yig du gzhan skad bsres nas mi mol ba dang / dngos gsar gyi thon rdzas rnams la bod skad kyi ming 'tshol zhib byas te shes bya'i khor yug nang bod skad kyi ming gis mi phongs bar bya rgyu rnams nga tso'i gzhon skyes rnams kyi mdun du dpyang ba'i 'gan 'khri gal chen zhig tu 'khums/19

daphyad ma/gnyis/ srol rgyun gyi shan shugs/spyi sger su yin yang dmigs yul bzang ngan las mi gzhi'i rin thang gi khyad par bsgrun thub kyi yod stabs/ rang cag su yin kyang chab dpal rig gsum gang rung gi rol rtsed la rang gis 'di byed snyam pa'i dmigs yul zhig gtan khel dgos pa yin la/gal te dmigs 'dun gyi gtad so med par byed thabs 'dra min la ji ltar snyegs kyang rlabs chen gyi bya bzhag gang yang bsgrun mi thub pa red/ de'i phyir dmigs yul yang dag zhig gtan khel ba'i sgo nas de'i byed thabs la 'bad 'bungs byed dgos pa ma zad/ brgyud pa dang ldan zhing / rigs pas dpyad bzod la/mkho dgos che ba'i nang bstan gyi rgyab ljongs yod par byed dgos snyam/de ltar dgos pa ni/ nga tsho'i yab mes gong ma rnams kyis 20

ba dgonargo rigadapetshog /srol rgyun gyi tshad tshang ba'i shes rig la rol te/ kha ba'i mi rigs 'di ya rab gzhung drang dang byams brtse can du kun gyi mthong snang du bsgrun yod pas/da lta'i char nga tshor 'gro ba mi'i zhi bde gong du spel ba'i mthun rkyen tshang bar khas len pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling hril bo'i mi gzhi'i mig dpe ru lta bzhin yod phyiraka de'i go skabs bzung ste nong bstan gyi rgyab ljongs yod par byed thub na/ 'u cag 'jig rten 'di nas rin thang can du bsgrun par brjod par spobs/gsum/ deng rabs kyi rig gzhungakabod kyi lo rgyus la phyi mig bgrad de blta dus lo rgyus kyi dkyogs mtshams re rer dar rgud kyi 'pho 'gyur ji snyed cig byung yod mod/chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi skabs su srid 'byor rig gsum gang du yang gzhan la smon mi dgos pa zhig byung yod pa de ri1

dpyad gagatso bo chig sgril la brten par shin tu gsal/ de rjes dus rabs mang po'i ring chos lugs 'then 'khyer dang / gral rim 'thab rtsod/ lung tshan dbye 'byed kyi shan shugs rnams la brten nas nyams rgud du gyur yod pa skya ris thang gsal du gyur/ der brten nga tshos sngon byung lo rgyus las nyams myong blangs te mthun sgril gyi lam bu'i thog nas rang byung gi chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar phan dngos dang ldan pa'i srol rgyun gyi steng du dus rabs gsar ba'i dngos khams dngakardzas 'gyur dpal 'byor rig pa bcas kyi kha gsab rgyu de phyi bshol cung zad kyang mi rung ba zhig tu nges/ de lta na'ang bod kyi gnas bab dang mthun la phan thogs dang ldan pa zhig bsdu len byed dgos pa las phyi nang gi dpal yon gang la mi mkho ba'i rigs bsdu len mi byed par yid gzab byed rgyu ni shin tu dgos gal che ba'i gnad don zhig tu 'khums/22

grwa ngatsun cho'i mdun rgyab kyi gnad don skor gyi lta tshul/'dzam gling gi rgyu skar 'di'i steng na mi'i spyi tshogs chags pa nas 'jigs dngangs dang thob shor gyi rigs mang du byung ba dag sel thabs su chos lugs rnams bsgrun dgos byung ba ltar/spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs lnga pa yas mas shig nas mnyam med zas gtsang sras kyis 'tshe ba med pa'i lam srol spel nas rgyun 'dzin du grwa btsun rnams 'tshol sdud gnang ste/khong tshor spyi tshogs khyon yongs kyi dka' rnyog sel phyir du drang brjod dang chog shes kyi byed sgo spel du bcugs yod/ de 'drar bcugs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'gro ba spyi'i rigs kyi rnyog 'dzing rnams 'dod rngam dang sger sems shugasadrags pa las byung bas/ drang brjod dang chog shes kyis de'i ri3

daphyad garigs dag 'bud thub pas red/ de'i phyir grwa btsun gyi rigs rim bzhin 'phags yul du 'phel rgyas chen po byung 'dug bod du yang rgyal blon dang che dgu rnams kyis zhi bde'i sgo 'phar bye phyir du rtsa 'dzugs byas te bod khams yongs su 'phel kha rgyas pa nas don dngos su rku 'phrog bcom gsum dang 'go skor baspu brid sogs nyung ngur phyin pa ma zad/ bod rang gi thun mong min pa'i rig gzhung dang gzhan gyi shes rig nang 'dren byed pas dpal yon yang mthor 'degs chen po zhig byed thub pasasbyi tshogs kyi khor yug tu grwa btsun gyi rin thang dang skya mer bar gyi mdza' 'brel ha cang dam zab caganas yod pa red/da lta'i grwa btsun gyi gnas bab/dus rabs nyi shu'i smad nas tshan rig lag rtsal dang dpal 'byor gyi 'phel kha rgyas te/ lta stangs dang goms gshis bcas kyi thog la kher tshugs dang rang rkya ba'i shan shugs chen po theb nas 2

babe+ed nane+e rigadaspartsag bzod sran dang phan tshun gus bkur bcas kyi rigs spyi tshogs nang nyams rlag tu gyur 'go btsugs yod pa red/ der brten grwa btsun mang che bas sdom khrims dam srung dang rgyal mtshams gyi khyad med par bzang spyod kyi khor yug bsgrun par 'bad 'bungs lhod med byas yod mod/ 'on kyang grwa btsun skor zhig pha ma'i dbang bsgyur gyi 'og nas byung stabs 'dul ba'i bslab khrims rang gi 'dod blor ma bab pa dang / khrom ra'i dpal 'byor dang rdzas 'phrul gyi bslu brid kyis ya rab tshul mthun gyi bya spyod las 'das te rku 'phrog sogs la 'jug bzhin yod la/yang 'ga' res chos kha la khyer te mgo skor gyi chos 'khor skor bzhin pa 'di'i rigs kyis skya ser gyi bar la 'gal ba bzo bzhin yod pa ma zad nyin re bzhin grwa btsun spyi yongs kyi rin thang la rgol rdung gtong gi 'dug da dung des rigs kyi rkyen byas te chos dang chos pa'i bzang ngan gyi he bag mi phye par chos lugs ni spyi tshogs kyi mdun skyod dang 'phel rgyas kyi bkag rdor bshad 25

dpyadartsom/mkhan yang mang du 'gro bzhin yod phyir da lta'i char sngar bzhin grwa btsun tshos rin thang bsgrun thub kyi med/ de'i phyir gnad don 'di'i rigs la thabs shes ji ltar bya dgos min grwa btsun tshos mno bsam gtong dgos snyam/ma 'ongs grwa btsun gyi lang phyogs/dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i dkyogs mtshams su spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs lnga pa yas mas shig tu 'go bus pa'i grwa btsun rnams kyis dgos mkho rlag med pa ma zad/ sngar bas kyang mkho dgos che ru 'gro bzhin yod/ de yang grwa btsun yang dag cig yin phyin 'dod rngam gyi rtse bcom slad du 'dul ba'i bcas khrims las ma 'das par spong ba bsam gtan dang klog pa thos bsam la 'bad 'bungs byed pa'i lam bu'i steng / g.yo rgyu khram gsum dang rdzun smra ba'i bya spyod ring du dor te drang bden dang bag yod kyi mig dpe bstan thub dgos pa red/26

ba dgonane+e rigadaspretshog /de tsam du ma zad gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i bya bar dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas zhugs te nang bstan gyi gzhi rtsa'i bden pa bzhi dang / byams snying rje/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis sogs kyi ngo sprad nas spyi tshogs khyon yongs la legs skyes 'bul dgos/ de dag lag len du khel ba la/ spyir yi ge 'bri klog dang sgom sgrub nyams len dang chos 'chad nyan sogs mi re re la yon tan sna mang 'dzoms dgos mod/'on kyang 'di'i rigs kyi grub 'bras gzings su thon pa zhig 'ong dka' bas gtso bo sgom sgrub dngaka thos bsam gang rung zhig gi thog la rang gi dga' mos dang lhan skyes kyi shes rab bed spyod byas te rigs gcig rkanga'adzin mkhan gso skyong thub tshe spyi tshogs hril bo'i bde don rlabs chen 'grub thub par sgrub phyogs nas brjod par spobs/ yin na'ang dgag phyogs nas grwa btsun skor zhig gis sdom brtson gyi bya spyod las 'das te/ tshong nyul dang 'chal spyod dang mgo skor sogs la 'gran rtsod byed pas 27

dpyadartsom/g.yo skyom 'dis gzhan la ngan bskul dang / grwa btsun spyi yongs kyi mtshan shas la gnod skyon chen po bzo bzhin yod stabs/ 'di'i rigs snang med du 'jog mi nyen par 'khums/ de la grwa btsun yongs kyi gnas bab dang mthun pa'i khrims gzhi zhig las mi 'da' ba'i rting 'dzin gyi 'og 'dul ba'i slob gso dang spyi'i go rtogs spel nas rang nyid grwa btsun zhig yin snyam pa'i 'du shes 'byung ched du grwa btsun nang khul du las 'gul spel dgos pa ma zad/ dad ldan spyi tshogs rnams kyis kyang grwa btsun spyod ngan gyi rigs ther 'don byas te skyon brjod dang lam ston skul slong sogs kyis sdom brtson rnal ma zhig yin pas khor yug bsgrun thub tshe/ da lta'i 'dzam gling nang 'byung bzhin pas dka' rnyog mang po zhig sel ba la phan thogs 'byung ba dang / grwa btsun tsho'i mdun lam la yang 'od stong 'phro bar gdon mi za'o/ /des na grwa btsun rnams kyis bya bzhag chung ngu zhig la mi lta bar gong gsal gyi las 'gul khrod du lang thub rgyu gal 'gangs shin tu che/28

ba dargonan rigadape tshog /bshad grwa'i skor gyi lta tshul mdo tsam brjod pa/nang ba'i bstan pa 'di thos bsam sgom gsum gyi lam nas 'dzin pa ni/ bstan pa gong 'phel du gtong byed kyi rtsa ba'i gnad don zhig yin pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs khyon yongs kyi zhi bde brtan barming dang khor yug srung skyobs sogs kyi 'gangs che'i don gnadacig tu grub yod phyir/ nang bstan shes rig gi ngo bo rgyud thog tu sbyar nas phan bde 'byung byed du 'dzin spel byed pa'i chos brgyud mang du byung yod pa las/ 'dir dpal ldan jo nang ba'i lta grub bshad grwa'i sgo nas 'dzin tshul gleng ba la/dang po/ lo rgyus las lam ston gnang tshul/29

dpyadartsom/dpal rgyal ba rdzo nang ba'i rdzogs ldan bstan pa'i snying bo 'di riston pa thub pa'i dbang bo nas klu thogs gnyis brgyud de mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i bar dpyad 'jog gi lam bu'i khrod nas nyams len du bstar mkhan mang du byung yod la/ lhag par kun mkhyen jo nang pa yab sras dang / rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po rnams kyis mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la gsan bsam mtha' yas pa mdzad de/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi thabs lam la brten nas dbu ma gzhan stong gi lta ba'i sgron me ches cher sbar yod pa lo rgyus kyi glegs bu'i khrod shin tu gsal stabs/ nga tshor des 'jug rim gyi lam ston ma nor ba zhig bstan yod par 'khums/de'i phyir 'u cag rgyal bstan spyi dang / bye brag thun min gyi lta grub gong mthor gtong phyir du bshad grwa'i lam la 'jug dgos par nges/gnyis pa/rang gi yig cha slob lam du 'dzin dgos/30

ba dgonane+esporinadasgetshogagaspyir lta grub 'dzin mkhan su yin yang slob sbyong gi brgyud lam gyi yig cha ni lta grub 'phel rgyas su gtong byed kyi rmang gzhir ngos 'dzin bzhin yod pa ltar/ nga tshos kyang rang gi chos brgyud kyi yig cha slob sbyong gi brgyud lam du ci nas kyang 'dzin thub dgos pa rid/gal srid de ltar ma thub par slob lam du yig cha gzhan bzung ba yin na des gzhan gyis lta grub dang goms gshis kyis shugs rkyen theb ste mi ring bar gzhan khongs su sim 'dzil byed par rang cag gi nyams myong las ra spyod thub pas na/ 'u cag gis rang gi mkhas dbang gong ma rnams kyi gsung slob lam du 'dzin rgyu ni nga tsho'i rgyab mdun la gzhugs tshe gal gnad ha cang chen po zhig tu nges/ de bas na da lta'i char phar tshad dbu gsum sngags dang bcas pa de rang rang gi yig cha'i thog 'chad khrid byed rgyu ni/ 'u cag gi thun min gyi lta grub srung skyobs thub pa'i kha tsha sgos gtugs kyi bya bzhag cig yin pa ma zad/ bod kyi rig gzhung cha tshang bdag srung byed pa'i thabs 'phrul zhig red snyam/31

dpyadartsom/gsum pa/ bshad grwa ba'i lta ba/spyir 'gro ba mi'i khrod du lta grub 'dra min sna tshogs pa zhig yod mod bshad grwa ba'i lta ba ni/ bshad tshod grags tshod tsam gyi rjes su mi spro bar bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du dpyad gsum gyis gnas tshul la dpyad zhib byasate sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang spyi tshogs la phan 'bras sgrub par 'dris che ba'i bsam blo'i lta tshul zhig tu zer la/ de ni rnam dpyod 'phel chad tsam min par 'gro ba spyi'i gnad don thag gcod byed dang / dus rabs la ches mkho ba'i blang bya gal chen zhig red/ der brten nga tshos lung rigs kyi lam nas thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i lta grub rnams phyag len bstar te 'khor 'das kyi gnad don thag gcod thub pa'i lta ba rgyun 'khyongs byed pa las nam yeng brgal mi nyen pa yin/32

ba dgonane+e rigadazhitshog /bzhi ba/ bshad grwa'i phan nus/da lta'i dus rabs kyi 'gyur khug gi khrod 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag gang la yang rigs pa yang dag gi lam nas zhib daphyod byas te 'phral phugs kyi dbye 'byed byed pa'i lta tshul tshad mtho ru 'gro bzhin yod stabs/ gzhung don bshad pa'am smra ba'i lam nas 'tshol sgrub byas na lugs gnyis gang la yang rnam daphyod rgyas shing dmigs 'bras rnams 'aspub par phan thogs che ba dang / lhag par lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gang nyams len du bstar na ngo bo dang /gol sa shes dgos mod/ de ltar ma shes par nyams su len khul ji ltar byas kyang lag rdum brag la 'dzegs par 'dra bas rgyal bstan 'thus tshang zhig 'dzin mi thub pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs kyi zhabs 'degs yang dag cig sgrub mi nus pas bshad grwa'i lam bu 'di 'khor 'das gnyis kyi nang du phan nus shin tu che bar 'khums/33

daphyad rtsam/lnga ba/lag len du 'debs tshul/lag len ni skye dngos 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa ba'i gnad don zhig yin pa ma zad yod tshad kyi sngon 'gro'i sgul shugs shig yin stabs/dgon sde so so nas bshad grwa'i khor yug btsugs te rgyun 'dzin du blo gsal don gnyer can rnams 'tshol sdud dang / spyi sems che la go rtogs mtho zhing / 'chad khrid la mkhas pa'i dge rgan dang /go rim ldan la tshags dam pa'i bslab deb dag nges par bsgrun dgos pa ma zad/ blo gros kyi rtsal myur du 'phar thub pa'i sgrig yig cig bzos te khrims kyis dbang bsgyur tu 'gro ba las gang zag gis dbang bsgyur tu mi 'gro ba zhig la 'bad 'bungs byed thub pa yin na/ bshad grwa'i ngo bo gong 'phel du 'gro bar the tshom bral/de bas na nga tshos nam yang kha bshad tsam la dad mos mi byed par lag len la yid rton dgos pa yin no//3

do naja ba'i 'gan bab gleng ba/ go la zlum po 'di'i steng du chos lugs khag sna mang dar te phan thog mi dman pa byung yod pa ltar/ bsil ldan gangs ri'i ljongs su yang dus rabs bdun pa nas rgyal blon dang lo paṇa rnams kyis nang bstan khyab spel gyi gom 'gros dang bstun te/ dpal ldan jo nang ba'i lta grub kyi srol 'dzin mkhan mang du byung nas/ rgyal bstan 'dzin spel thog phyag rjes chen po bzhag yod mod/ 'on te nye ba'i dus rabs nang chos brgyud 'di'i lta sgom rnams nyams zhan du 'gro bzhin yod stabs/ 'u cag gis gong mthor gtong ba la ji dgos skor rags tsam gleng na/dang po/ grub mtha'i srog rtsa/35

dpyad grub mtha' gang yin min gyi khyad par de/lta ba'i sgo nas 'jog dgos stabs/ kun mkhyen jo nang ba'i 'phags yul mkhas pa'i legs bshad la brten nas lung rigs phon chen po'i srol phye ba'i lta spub 'di bdag srung dang / khyab spel byed rgyu de chos brgyud kyi gnad don zhig yin pa ma zad/ nang bstan la phan pa'i bya bzhag 'gangs chen zhig yin pa bsnyon du med/'on te gzhan la ngom chog pa'i lta grub 'di rgyun 'khyongs byed pa'i 'du shes spangs te bdag nyid bslu brid gtong byed kyi rol rtsed la mgo 'khor nas bsnad pa'am/ yang na grub mtha' la dad mos tsam byas te bsnad pa yin na/ mjug 'bras su chos brgyud 'di ring min ming gi lhag ma tsam du 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ de'i stabs kyis dpal ldan jo nang ba'i lta ba 'di bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi lam nas 'dzin skyong byed rgyu de gzhi rtsa'i gnad don zhig tu 'khums/36

ba dginane+e rigadapetshog gnyis pa/gong 'phel du ji ltar gtong tshul/spyir grub mtha' 'di brtan barming dang gong 'phel du gtong ba la sngon du nyams zhan du 'gro byed kyi rkyen rtsa dag ngos ma zin par yar rgyas su 'gro thabs med pa red/der brten chos brgyud 'di'i lo rgyus kyi lam bu'i khrod du brtags dpyad byas tshe dus rabs nyi shu pa nas bshad sgrub zung 'brel la lhod yang shor ba dang /chig sgril gyi nus pa zhan pa dang / grub mtha' 'dzin spel byed pa'i lam ston dang sgrig 'dzugs 'thus tshang zhig med pa'i dbang gis nye ba'i lo rabs du ma'i ring rlabs chen gyi 'bras bu gang yang 'byin ma thub par gnas yod mod/ 'on te da dung gol sa 'di dag gi rigs la do snang ma byas par mu mthud du bstan pa 'dzin khul byas kyang chos brgyud 'di brtan gnas su 'gyur thabs med pa ma zad/ chos brgyud der phugs bsam gtan nas med pa'i gtan tshigs phyir 37

dpyadartsomangom byas pa red/ de'i phyir nga tshos slob gso'i byed sgo sna tshogs spel te/ spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo legs lam dang / go rtogs can du btang ste skyon yon gyi he bag dang / rang gi kha phyogs gsal zhing gtad so can du 'gyur thabs su brtson dgos la/ da lta 'tsho gnas byed bzhin pa'i dgon sde so so nas bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi lam srol la 'bad 'bungs bgyis te lag len du bstar thabs su tshang mas phyar spu mnyam 'degs byed thub na 'phel rgyas kyi mtho rlabs 'phyur bar nges/gsum pa lang phyogs/ lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs la phyir dran dang dngos don la gzu bos bltas tshe nga tshos snying stobs dang lhag bsam gyi lam nas mdun du skyod dgos/de yang zab mo gzhan stong gi lta ba'i rgyas bcings te dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag dang phar tshad dbu gsum rnams/ bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi lam nas 'chad spel thub dgos pa ma zad/38

ba dgonargo rigadapetshogasa'acham mthun mnyam las kyi sgo nas zhi bde'i ngo bor legs skyes 'bul ba'i lang phyogs brtan por 'dzin dgos la/'di dag rang cag gi byed thub dgos pa las gzhan nas 'dzin mkhan zhig 'ong rgyu med pas/ nga tshos 'das pa'i lo rgyus las nyams myong bsdu len dang ma 'ongs pa'i dgos dmigs la tshod dpag byas te dpal ldan rgyal ba jo nang ba'i mdo sngags gnyis kyi bstan pa bla nas bla ru 'phel bar gnang rgyu ni 'dor du med pa'i las bya zhig tu 'khums/39

dadzid ma/bgro gleng gi skor gyi lta tshul/chos brgyud cig gi 'phel rgyas kyi go rim khrod du grub mtha'i ngo bo mthor 'degs dngaka 'phel rim 'thus tshang can du gtong pa la sngon dus nas dar so che ba'i rig pa'i bgro gleng byed pa'i srol de med du mi rung ba zhig yin stabs/ nga tsho'i yab mes gong ma rnams kyis de'i thog la 'bad 'bungs chen po byas yod par ma zad/ dus rabs mang po'i ring la 'grogs 'dris byas te rgyal bstan dang de 'dzin mkhan tshad thub cig yong bar phyag rjes chen po zhig 'jog thub yod mod/ 'on kyang nye ba'i lo rabs mang po'i ring / 'u cag la legs byang de'i skor rgyun chad de gzhan gyi thob skal zhig yin pa las/ nga tsho rol mi nyan la/ gal srid rol tshe chos brgyud cig gi la rgya shor bar bsam mkhan du ma zhig byung myong yod pa red/ de lta na'ang dus rabs kyi 'gyur 'gros zhig gis nga 40

ba dgonane+ernarigadapetshog /tshor mig zhags ring du mi btang thu med byung ste rdzogs ldan bstan pa'i dag ther la phan byed kyi lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i snga srol bzang po yang bskyar 'go 'bus thub pa byungakabagro gleng dngos kyi gnas bab/dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i lo rabs gsum pa yas mas shig nas rim bzhin bgro gleng gi lam khar bskyod thub rgyu ni lta grub cig dang bshad sgrub cig yar skul yong ba'i byed thabs nyag gcig tu mthong ste/ 'bad brtson chen po'i sgo nas rab rgyan me khyi lor dpal ldan jo nang ba'i dgon sde tshang ma mnyam 'brel gyi thog nas bgro gleng dngos su 'tshogs thub pa ma zad/ kun mkhyen jo nang ba'i lta grub gyi gtsos phar tshad dbu gsum gyi gzhung la mthun sgril shin tu yod pa'i rnam pa'i steng nas bgro gleng byas te/ sngon med kyi chos sgra gsar ba zhig bsgrags pa des bshad sgrub gang ci'i thad la 41

dpyadartsom/grags 'gul chen po zhig btang thub mod/ yin na'ang de'i gnas bab dpyad tshe bgro gleng 'di/ yang bskyar du 'go 'bus pa tsam yin stabs/spyi'i cha nas rigs lam dwangs gtsang zhig yin pa la zhan cha che ba dang / bgro gleng la ngar shugs de tsam med pa dang /sger gyi rgyal pham zhig gi rnam par lta mkhan mang ba dang / dam bca' ba rnams la gzhan brten gyi rnam pa rnams shugs che bas/da dung nga tshos dus rabs sprel mtshams 'dir bgro gleng byed thub pa tsam la dad mos mi byed par/ rjes sor 'di dag la do snang byed rgyu shin tu gal che ba zhig red/ 'on te zhan cha'i rnam pa 'di dag la kha gtad ma byas par bag yangs su shor ba yin na nga tshor phan pa las gnod pa che ba gdon mi za'o//'phel rgyas su ji ltar gtongatshul/cig byas na gzhan stong gi bgro gleng byed thub pa 'di ni nyams zhan gyi khrod nas mtshar longs byung ba'i skyestobs shig yin stabs/42

ba dginane+e rigadapetshog /nga tshos bgro gleng gi rnam pa 'di ri bo hi ma la yi rtse ru bskyon te/ris med kyi daphyod ldan pa rnams la drang bden gyi sdom tshig 'jog thub dgos kyin 'dugade la thog mar dgon sde so so nas ma skul dang blang gi sgo nas 'jug thabs la brtson te chig sgril gyi rmang gzhi bsgrun rgyu ni rtsa ba'i rgyu cha zhig red la/ de'i steng du dam bca' ba dag gis lan 'debs pa'i dus tshod ring du btang ste rang gi dam bca' ba'i steng du lung rigs rno ngar can gtong ba la dpang bzhugs dge rgan tshos 'gan khur ba yin na/ bgro gleng 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba ma zad rin thang can du 'gyur thub nges red/ gal srid de las sdog ste bgro gleng ba mang du bzhag nas gzhan brten gyi rnam pa'i steng nas dus tshod 'khyongs thabs byed pa'i srol de rgya yan du skyur ba yin na bgro gleng 'di byis pa'i rol rtsed tsam las rin thang can du 'gyur mi thub pa ma zad/ lo re gnyis las bgro gleng gi sku tshe 'tsho mi thub par nges/ de bas na don dam pa'i bgro gleng rnal ma 3

dpyadartsogazhig yong ba la sgrig yig 'thus tshang zhig bzos te de'i stangs 'dzin gyi 'og tu bskyod thub dgos pa dang / rim bzhin bgro gleng gi lam bu brgyud nas sgrub pa dang bshad pa'i rkang 'dzin mkhan mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig yong ba la 'cham mthun mnyam las kyi byed thabs spel rgyu ni da yod kyi dgon sde so so nas nges par 'tshol snyegs bya dgos pa'i shin tu 'gangs che'i don gnad zhig tu 'khums/der brten nga tshos dus rabs kyi 'gyur khug gi khrod skyes stobs 'phel ba'i bgro gleng 'di la gson shugs sprad thub dgos pa las ngo bo lhag med du bskyar ba yin na 'u tshos gang yang mi 'jon la ci yang mi thub pa'i nus med cig yin pa'i gtan tshigs phyir ngom byas pa red snyam/44

ba dargonane+e rigadapetshog /gzhan stong gi lta ba'i gnad la rags tsam dpyad la/bsil ljongs mkhas mang rgyu skar bkra ba'i ltor/rnam dag lung rigs zla shel rab tu'aphags//mthar thug dbu ma'i legs bshad 'od dkar gyis//rgyal bstan rgyas mdzad jo nang ba la 'dud//gang gi zab brling mkhyen pa'i zer rnon gyis//rgyal kun dgongs bcud nges don sgeg mo'i dpal//legs bkral gtsug lag nges don rgya mtsho yi//dgongs don 'tshol ba'i thabs 'phul su yis 'gog/ces mchod par brjod pa'i snyan pa'i 'gyur khug gis mdun bsus te/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs bcud gzhi dbyings bde 45

dpyadartsom/gshegs snying bo gzhan stong yin min gyi skor dpyad pa la/kha cig thog mar gzhan stong gi lta ba 'phags yul du gtan la 'beb mkhan med zer na/ de ni legs par ma brtags pa ste/ bdagacag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang bos 'khor lo tha ma'i skabs snying bo'i mdo bcu'i sgo nas nges don mthar thug gi lta ba dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor byas nas bstan pa ltar rgyal tshab mi pham pas byams chos snga ma rnams dang / lhag par rgyud bla ma'i skabs gsal bar gsungs la/ gang gi thugs sras 'phags pa thogs med kyis sa sde lnga dang rgyud bla ma'i 'grel ba sogs su rtsal du bton nas 'grel 'dug de rjes mnga' bdag me tri bas dga' ba'i rdo rje la gnang / de nas san dza nas gsan yod/ des gzu btsan gnyis la bstsal ba ma zad gzu lo tsā bas sa dza na dang mthun par rgyud bla'i 'grel ba yang mdzad nas nges don dbu ma'i bshad pa rgya cher gnang ba'i rgyun/ rgyal ba'i lung zin gyi skyes mchog kun mkhyen jo nang bas lung rigs rgya chen pos gtan la 46

0 dgonane+e rig dpe ga /phab pa'i phyir/ yang kun rdzob thams cad rang stong dang / don dam 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gzhan stong du 'dod pa la/dbu mar khas 'che ba 'gas/ de mi 'thad pa thal/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos dang chos nyid thams cad rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa yin la/ des stong ba'i stong nyid gnas lugs mthar thug yin pa'i phyir zer na/ rtags ma grub gle stong nyid chen po'i mdor/ gang la gang la med pa de ni des stong la zhes yang dag par ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes la/ de la lhag mar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 'di na yod pa'o/ /zhes dang / dbus mtha' las/dngos po med 'di stong pa nyid/ /de dngos med pa'i dngos yod pa/ /de ni de las stong nyid gzhan/ /zhes kun rdzob thams cad dang rang stong dang / don dam chos nyid gzhan stong du gsal bar gsungs pa'i gnod pa bzlog mi thub pa'i phyir/ bden gnyis gsal ba'i nyi ma las/ kun rdzob rang stong dngaka don dam gzhan stong du gsungs pa'i gnod pa ji ltar bzlog ces gsungs pa'i 7

dpyadartsogaphyir/gzhan yang / khyod kyis mdo las/ de bzhin nyid de bzhin nyid kyis stong / yang dag pa'i mtha' yang dag pa'i mthas stong ba'i don/ sgra ji bzhin par 'dod dam/ khyad par gyi tshig sbyar nas bshad/ dang po ltar na/ de bzhin nyid chos can/ khyod de bzhin nyid kyis mi stong ste/ khyod chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ khyab rtags grub ste/klu sgrub kyis/ de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'//mtshan ma med dang don dam nyidakubyang chub sems mchog de bzhin dang / /stong pa nyid du bshad pa yin/ /zhes dang / dbus mtha' las/ stong pa nyid de mdor bsdus na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dngaka /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /zhes dang / nya ṭīka las/ gal te de bzhin nyid sogs don dam bden pa min zer na/ lung yang dag du ma dang 'gal ba ma zad/ don dam bden pa med par 'gyur ba'i skyon yang yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/8

ba dginargo rigadapetshog /gnyis pa khyad par gyi tshig sbyar te kun rdzob tu grub pa'i gzugs sogs don dam par bden par grub pa'i stong tshul la sbyar zer na/ 'o na/de 'dra'i stong tshul de yang gzhan stong gi stong tshul yin par thal/ bstan pa spyi 'grel gyi ṭīka las/ kun rdzob tu grub pa'i gzugs ni don dam par grub pa'i gzugs sogs kyis stong zhes pa gzhan stong yin zhingaka zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang de 'dra'i stong pa gzhan stong yin par thal/ de gtsug lag khang dge slong gis stong pa ma yin par thag khra sbrul gyis stong ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ stong gzhi thag pa dang ngo bo tha dad pa'i gzhan sbrul gyis stong ba yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar stong tshul skor la dpyad bya mang ngoka /rang lugs la kun rdzob thams cad rang stong yin du chug kyangakaganas lugs mthar thug pa'i chos sku bde gshegs snying bo rang gi ngo bo bden pas mi stong bar gshis la spub cingaka gzhan dri ma glo bur ba'i stong bas na gzhan stong du 'dod pa yin te/ rgyud bla ma 49

dpyadartsom/las/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /zhes khams de rnam par dbye ba dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid dang glo bur dri mas stong ba'i gzhan stong du gsungs la/lang gshegs las/ 'phags pa'i ye shes stong pa nyid chen po gang zhe na/ bdag gi so sor rang gi 'phags pa'i ye shes khong du chud pa ni lta ba dang nyes pa'i bag chags thams cad kyis stong ste/ de'i phyir don dam pa 'phags pa'i ye shes stong pa chen po nyid ces bya'o//zhes dang / sor 'phreng gi mdor/ 'jam dpal gang grong khyer rtsig pa'i khyim stong pa ni mi med pas stong ngoka /zhes pa nas/ de bzhin du thar ba dang thams cad kyis stong pa ma yin gyi nyes pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir thar ba stong ba zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni stong pa ma yin te/ nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing / nyon mongs bya ba'i ming dang lha med pa'i stong zhes bya'o/ /zhes mdo snga phyi gnyis kyis nyes pa'i dri ma thams cad zhes tshig gi nus pa bton nas gzhan stong bstan yod la/ 'phag30

bse dgon shes rig dpe tshogs/sa pa thogs med kyis kyang / gang la gang med pa de ni des stong la/ /lhag ma gang yin pa de ni yod pa'o/ /zhes gzhi chos dbyings gang la chos can kun rdzob kho nas stong pa yin zhing / stong tshul 'di la lhag ma chos nyid gang yin pa de ni yod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar lung de dag la brten nas chos dbyings gzhan stong du nges par grub po/ /'on te/ chos nyid bden par grub pas stong pa thal/ bdag gnyis kyis stong ba'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ ri chos las/ bde gshegs snying po bdag gnyis kyis stong pa'i phyir mu stegs byed kyi bdag dang mi mtshungs zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na bde gshegs snying po gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gis stong zhing / gshis la bden par grub pa yin te/ri chos las/ chos de dag gis stong pa'i gzhi chos nyid kyi ngo bor nam yang bzhugs pa ni rang gis mi stong yang/ zhes dang / bstan pa spyi 'grel gyi ṭīka las/ don dam bden pa ni don dam nyid du 51

dpyad rtsom/grub pa'i zhes sogs sngar bshad pa ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/'o na/ dgag bya'i bdag la ji ltar 'jog snyam na/ kun rdzob rnams gnas lugs su grub pa 'jog ste/ ri chos las/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams gnas lugs su gtan nas med pa yin yang yod do zhes sgro 'dogs pa/ zhes dang / gang zag dang chos su gtogs pa'i dngos po thams cad gnas lugs su gtan med kyang ma grub pa'i phyir/ rang rang ngo bos stong pa ste/ /zhes sogs pa'i phyir/yang gzhan stong gi stong nyid stong nyid tha shal yin par thal/lang gshegs las/ gcig gis gcig stong ba'i stong nyid tha shal du gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/ lang gshegs su gcig gis gcig stong ba'i stong nyid tha shal du gsungs pa de khang ba mis stong ba ltar/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams phan tshun gcig gis gcig stong pa'i stong nyid lta bu la dgongs par mdo de nyid las gsungs shing /de dang don dam rang bzhin pa de kun rdzob glo bur ba'i chos rnams 52

babe+edagonane+e rigadapetshogagakyis stong pa ni khyad par che bas kyang shin tu che ba'i phyir te/ mdo de nyid las/ blo gros 'phags pa ye shes stong pa nyid chen po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ zhes pa nas stong nyid chen po nyid ces bya'o/ /zhes stong nyid bdun gyi nang nas chos nyid lta ba dngaka nyes tshogs mtha' dag gis stong pa'i stong nyid chen por gsungs pa'i phyir/ri chos las/ de dang don dam rang bzhin pa de kun rdzob glu bur ba'i chos rnams kyis stong pa ni khyad par che las kyang shin tu che ba'i phyir/ zhes dang / de'i phyir kun rdzob stong pa nyid la dgongs nas gcig gis gcig stong pa de stong nyid tha shal yin pas spangs par gsungs la/ de ni de kho na ltar kho bo cag kyang 'dod pa yin no/ /khyab pa khas/ rtags don bsdus kyis grub pa'i phyir zer na/rtags ma grub ste/ don bsdus las za bo nang gi dngos rnams kyi/nas/ rab tu dbye ba bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de/ dbus mtha' las/ za dang bza' ba de yi lus/ /nas/ de bzhin der ni stong pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ gzhung des stong pa 53

dasud ma/nyid stong pa nyid sogs don dam mtshan nyid yin par ma bstan pa'i phyir te/ de'i stong gzhi la stong nyid shes pa'i shes pa zhig 'jog pa'i phyir/ dbyig gnyen gyi dbus mtha'i 'grel ba las/nang gi skye mched la sogs pa gang gis stong bar mthong zhe na/ stong pa shes pa'i de/ de'i stong nyid ni stong pa nyid nyi shu thams cad rang stong du 'dod pa ma yin par/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid don dam gzhan stong du 'dod pa yin la/ de yang ri chos las/ stong nyid nyi shu thams cad rang stong nyid du smra ba ni/rgyal ba rnams kyi dgongs pa chen po'i don ma yin te/ zhes pa nas/dngos po med pa'i ngo bo dang gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid rnams stong nyid yin yang rang stong ma yin pa'i phyir ro//zhes gsungs pas 'dir chos nyid dngos po dang dngos med gang rung du kha tshon gcod pa ni don dam pa'i gnas lugs ma gtogs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ ri chos las/ shes bya thams cad dngos po dngos med gnyis su kha tshon chod par smra ba rnams kyis ni 54

ba dgon rigadaspretshog chos nyid don dam pa'i gnas lugs ma gtogs pa nyid du zad de/de ni shes bya yin yang / dngos po dang dngos med gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/smras pa/rnam dag lung dang rigs pa la brten nas//rnam bcas lta grub gzhan stong yid bzhin nor//rnam mang skye 'phags dpyid du legs drangs tekurnam kun dbyings 'dir brtson par e ma ho/

dasudartsogachos dbyings gcig du bral gyi rigs pa'i sgrub mub min skor daphyad pa/chos dbyings gcig du bral gyi rigs pa'i sgrub thub min skor dpyad pa la gnyis las/ thog mar snang grags kyi chos rnams gcig du bral gyi rigs pas sgrub pa'i tshul dang / chos dbyings gcig du bral gyi rigs pas sgrub mi thub par bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/ bden spub kyi gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma grub na bden par med pas khyab/ dper na gzugs brnyan bzhin/dngos po rnams bden par ma grub po//zhes sgrub dgos te/ dbu ma bzhi brgya ba las/ dngos po gang gang rnam brtags na/ /de dang de la gcig pa med/ /gang la gcig pa yod min pa/ /de la du ma'ang med pa yin/ /zhes dngaka rnam 'grel las/ gang gis dngos rnams 56

ba dgona'e rigadaspatshogaganges brtags na/ /yang dag tu na dngos med de/ /'di ltar de dag gcig pu dngan/du ma'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/'di'i tshul sgrub pa la/ phyogs chos dngaka khyab pa sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dngos po rnams chos can/ bden grub gyi gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma grub ste/ bden grub kyi gcig du ma grub pa gang zhig du mar ma grub pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de chos can/ de'i gcig tu ma grub par thal/ cha bcas yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snang grags kyi chos rnams gang yin yang yul yul can dang spyi dang rang rang gi cha gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma rgyan las/ gcig dang du ma ma gtogs pas/ /rnam pa gzhan dang ldan pa yi/ /dngos po mi rung 'di gnyis ni/ /phan tshun spangs te gnas phyir ro//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ bden spub kyi du mar med de/ de'i gcig tu med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bden grub kyi du ma 57

dasudartsogabaden grub kyi gcig bsags pa las byung ba'i phyir te/ theg mchog dbu ma'i zin bris las/ bsags bya'i gcig med pa'i phyir na de bsags pas du ma shugs la rigs pa yin zhing / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa khyab sgrub ni/ phyi rgol de'i blo ngor de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs la yod kyang de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs las ldog mi dgos snyam na/ de dgos pa thal/ snang grags kyi chos rnams de'i gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma grub na bden par med pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de rnams bden par spub na bden grub kyi gcig dang du ma gang rung du grub dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/gcig dang du ma phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi dngos 'gal yin pa'i phyir/ dbu ma rgyan las/ gcig dang du ma ma gtogs pa'i/ /rnam pa gzhan dang ldan pa yi/ /dngos po mi rung 'di gnyis ni/ /phan tshun spangs te gnas phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gcig dang du ma phan tshun spangs 'gal du nges pa'i tshad ma dang 58

ba dgogagi rig dathetshogagaphyogs chos nges pa'i tshad ma gnyis kyi byed pa la brten nas rtags mi mthun phyogs la med nges dang / mthun phyogs la yod pa kho nar nges pa'i rjes su 'gro ldog gi khyab pa grub thub po/ /༈ gnyis pa don dam gcig du bral gyi rigs pa'i sgrub mi thub pa'i skor bshad pa la/ chos nyid gcig du bral gyi rigs pas sgrub mi thub ste/ khyod gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma grub kyang /bden med yin mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ sngon med legs bshad las/ don dam ni gcig dang du ma las 'das kyangaka zhes dngakabastan pa spyi 'grel gyi rnam bshad las/ rtag tu bden par yod ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na don dam chos dbyings gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma spub kyang bden med yin mi dgos par rigs pa'i dpyad bzod du bden par grub pa yin la/ 'on te skabs rer gcig gi rnam bzhag gsungs yod pa ni tha snyad tsam la dgongs pa yin pa dang / theg marjog dbu ma'i zin bris las/yang don dam de chos can/ rang bzhin gyi ma grub ste/ khyod gcig 59

dpyad /dang du ma gang rung du ma grub pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ de la 'gal khyab yin te/ gcig dang du ma gang rung du grub na/ rang bzhin gyi grub pa bud do/ /zhes pa ni yod pa gzhir bzhag ste 'gal khyab la bud pa dang / don thob gtso bor byas nas de ltar gsungs pa yin snyam mo//60

ba dginazhi rinadapetshog /ririg lam thogasar dga' skyed/mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i tshig don 'o mtsho'i 'jingasakurnam daphyod rtsal gyis 'dod rgu la 'thung ste/mkhas mdun rdo rje rigs 'phrul 'bum gtor bsakukun mkhyen mtshan gyi cod paṇa bcing bas skyongs//zhes snyan tshig gi chun pos mdun bsus te rtsod pa'i rnam bzhag gi skor mdor bsdus zhig gleng bar bya ba la/ bod du rtsod pa'i byung rim dang / rtsod pa'i rnam bzhag dngos/ zhar byung rtsod pa'i bya spyod dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bsil ldan gangs ri'i ljongs su rab byung dang po'i shing stag spyi lo(1༷64/la rjog legs pa'i shes rab kyis btab pa'i gsang phu'i dgon pa ru rngog 61

daphyad gablo ldan shes rab kyis rnam 'grel dang phar phyin dbu ma bcas kyi bshad khrid gnang ste/ dus thung nang zur khrid thub pa'i slob ma chig stong brgyad brgya lhag tsam byung la/ de rjes zhang tshe spongs chos kyi bla mas gsang phu'i gdan sa mdzad skabs cha ba chos kyi seng ges tshad ma zur khrid gnang ba tsam du ma zad/ lung rigs kyi bgro gleng byed thabs su slob gnyer pa rnams so sor kha gtad byas te bgro gleng gtong ba dang /skabs rer res mos kyis dam bca' btsugs su bcugs te de la khas len dri ba dngakakhas blang der sun 'byin gtong tshul dang / rtsod pa rno ngar can du 'gyur ched du thal skad gtong tshul sogs kyi thabs 'phrul sna tshogs zhig gsar btod mdzad 'dug ma zad/ 'dzin grwa yas mas gtugs res dang 'dzin grwa 'og ma'i gras nas slob gnyer legs gras rnams 'dzin grwa gong mar 'phar ba dang / tshogs chen mnyam tshogs sar grwa skor dam bca' 'jog tu bcug pa bcas kyis slob gnyer 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i thabs shes mang po zhig byed pa'i spos rim bzhin sa skya 6lha

ba dgon rgo rigadasge tshogagadang ngam ring rtse chen chos sde sogs su dar la/ phyis su rim bzhin thog mar blo sgo phye phyir du bsdus grwa dang rnam 'grel/ de rjes nang bstan gyi rmang gzhi 'ding ba'i phyir phar phyin dngaka nang ba'i lta tshul nges phyir du dbu ma/ de nas theg pa chung ba'i bsam tshul shes phyir mngon pa dang / mthar nang ba'i 'dul khrims kyi lag len rtogs phyir du 'dul ba bcas lo dus grangs bcad kyi 'dzin grwa khag bgos pa'i srol bod chol kha gsum gyi khongs su dar te da lta'i bar gnas thub pa byung yod/smras pa/rgya bod mkhas grub bye ba'i mkhyen gter las//legs 'khrungs phra zhib rigs pa'i gsang tshig 'bumakubasil ljongs 'dzin ma'i 'phang bar bzhad pa'i tshal//shes ldan bung ba dga' ba'i dpyid du rdzogs//zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/63

dpyad gaganyis pa rtsod pa'i rnam bzhag dngos la/rtsod pa'i ngo bo ngos bzung ste rtsod pa bya tshul dang / lan 'debs stangs/ rigs 'phul skor cung tsam bshad pa dang gsum las/dang po/gzhan gyis rang gi khas len la mi mthun par smra ba'i sgras bsdus pa'i chos de rtsod pa'i ngo bo yin par go dgos la/ rtsod pa bya tshul yang dam bca'i rgyun skyong bar byed pa'am sgrub byed 'god par byed pa'i snga rgol lam rigs lung ba dngaka snga rgol gyis lung rigs kyi sgrub byed 'god pa'i don de dag yin min du lan 'debs pa'i phyir rgol lam dam bca' ba gnyis 'dzoms te/rigs lung bas gang brjod pa'i brjod don de rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum tshang ba'i thal 'gyur bkod naso rtsod dgos la/de yang chos dung dkar po'i kha dog chos can/ dkar po yin 6
